body.text: Implemented the v2 terminal epoch receipt envelope and v6 compaction replay support. It preserves optional provider/model/route coordinates plus digest-checked command argv; v5 hash-only epochs remain explicitly unknown. No new live terminal provider usage occurrence was captured in this work. Executable next baton: have the epoch compactor emit terminal_epoch_receipt from terminal_epoch_receipt_envelope(epoch) before deleting command.json, then capture and independently replay the next Codex attempt.

subject: V6 epoch envelope ready; prospective live capture remains
